2. Second loop: all updates to `v` (line 7) using the fully-updated `u` from the first loop

This breaks the intra-loop dependence on `v` while preserving output semantics—the second loop sees all updates to `u` just as in the original sequential execution where each `v` update used the immediately-computed `u`. The index expressions within each loop are unchanged, so DiscoPoP can now analyze each independently for parallelism.
